directions.title: Run index with persistent record context
directions.summary: A searchable index of five saved Runs opens a persistent record detail view that keeps Run identity, task, session, artifact reference, and reported connection status together. A distinct preview route returns to the index and makes no claim of Run provenance.

directions.title: Chronological Run stream with explicit preview return
directions.summary: A dated stream presents saved Run records in sequence, with each entry carrying its own task, session, artifact reference, and reported connection status. The stream provides a direct selected-preview route and a labeled return path; sequence does not imply causal relationship or preview provenance.

directions.title: Guided record inspection with explicit checkpoints
directions.summary: A focused inspection flow guides a reader through locating one of five saved Runs, checking its associated fields and reported connection status, and optionally opening a separately selected preview before returning to reidentify the record. The flow organizes inspection steps without implying that the saved focus is restored.

directions.title: Shared comparison board for saved Run records
directions.summary: A comparison board puts the five saved Run records in aligned columns under common field labels so readers can inspect their task, session, artifact reference, and monitor-reported connection status side by side. A separately selected preview remains a distinct destination; a separate design review route compares candidate monitor structures for a human decision.

decision.rationale: Recommend the persistent searchable Run index as the leading review candidate because it combines direct location with record context and a separately labeled preview path.
